title: Creation from nothing.
html_source:
A link back to the first chapter; Haines and Stephen’s brief conversation on belief: “You’re not a believer are you… in the narrow sense of the word. Creation from nothing and miracles and a personal god.”

Also a brief reference to the creation of the universe from nothing (by a god or otherwise) and to Stephen’s own creation from the nothingness he previous “existed” in. However Stephen’s fantasy of a birth from oblivion is quashed by a thought of a dead baby.
